title: How long can the curve of the Li coefficients keep bending the same way? Introductory text to Sign runs and the density of sign changes of Keiper-Li second differences
description: A plain-language introduction to a research paper on sign runs, and the density of sign changes, of the Keiper-Li second differences. The paper has the proofs; this note has the idea, and it says what the paper does and does not claim.
